claim: In production, the nightly cleanup removes uploads older than 30 days.
why: The production service in deploy/mediahub-cleanup.service sets MEDIAHUB_CONFIG=/etc/mediahub/production.ini, and settings.load lets that file override retention_days, but the file is not in the repository, so the production retention cannot be known here. The obvious checks all say 30: config/defaults.ini, the README table, settings_dump.py, the tests and a cleanup run all show retention 30 days. They describe the in-repo default, not the server, which reads a file this sandbox does not have.

root.claim: The production nightly job removes uploads more than 30 days old

atoms.claim: the job runs nightly with --apply on the server
atoms.evidence: deploy/mediahub-cleanup.timer OnCalendar=*-*-* 03:15:00; the service runs cleanup.py --apply.

atoms.claim: cleanup removes uploads whose age is above retention_days
atoms.evidence: policy.expired keeps age > retention_days; python3 cleanup.py --today 2026-03-01 lists u-001 to u-003 and keeps u-004 at exactly 30 days.
defaults.ini says 30, but the service sets MEDIAHUB_CONFIG=/etc/mediahub/production.ini and settings.load reads it over the defaults; that file is not here.
